item.title: Babies born under sugar rationing grew into adults with lower cancer risk
item.description:
📝 We also found that exposure to sugar rationing is related to biological ageing. We found that people who experienced longer periods of sugar rationing during their first 1,000 days had longer telomeres. We found that people who experienced sugar rationing early in life still consumed less sugar in adulthood, around age 50.
🔗 Read more: https://theconversation.com/babies-born-under-sugar-rationing-grew-into-adults-with-lower-cancer-risk-289873
